extension.description: Download and upload robot programs (JOB, DAT, CND, …) from and to YASKAWA YRC1000 controllers via FTP. Unofficial – not affiliated with YASKAWA.
capabilities.untrusted: Controller connections and upload on save are disabled in untrusted workspaces.
welcome.noFolder:
Open a folder for your robot project. Downloaded files are stored there.
[Open Folder](command:vscode.openFolder)
welcome.noController:
Connect VS Code to a YASKAWA YRC1000 controller to download and upload jobs and data via FTP.
[Add Robot Controller](command:yrc1000.addController)
You need the IP address of the controller and an FTP user configured on it.
config.controllers: Robot controllers of this workspace. Use **YRC1000: Add Robot Controller…** to add one. Passwords are never stored here but in the VS Code secret storage.
config.controllers.name: Display name, e.g. cell or robot number.
config.controllers.host: IP address of the YRC1000 controller.
config.controllers.username: FTP user configured on the controller.
config.controllers.password: Optional FTP password in plain text. If set, it takes precedence over the password in the VS Code secret storage. **Warning:** anyone with access to this file, or to a repository it is committed to, can read it.
config.controllers.localFolder: Local folder relative to the workspace. Empty = workspace root.
config.controllers.downloadFolders: Controller folders for 'Download Default Folders'. Overrides yrc1000.downloadFolders.
config.downloadFolders: Controller folders downloaded by **YRC1000: Download Default Folders**, e.g. `JOB`, `DAT`, `CND`, `SYS`, `PRM`.
config.confirmUpload: Ask for confirmation before files are uploaded to the controller.
config.checkJobHeader: Before a job (.JBI) is uploaded, compare its header with the job on the controller and warn if global position variables (P, BP, EX), positions of the job or a newer controller version would be overwritten.
config.uploadOnSave: Upload a file to the active controller automatically when it is saved. Only applies to files inside a controller folder such as `JOB/`.
config.timeout: Timeout in milliseconds for connecting and for controller replies.
